result.title: From Intelligence to Autonomy: Foundations and Construction of Autonomous Agents for Future Intelligent Systems
result.summary: Artificial intelligence is moving from one-off perception and generation tasks toward long-term planning, tool use, and interaction with real environments. Greater task competence, however, does not automatically yield autonomy: an external actor may still have to set goals, sustain operating conditions, detect failures, and approve updates. We define an autonomous agent as a system that, within explicit identity and authority boundaries, maintains both task goals and viability conditions, acts continuously using models of the world and itself, and adjusts its control mechanisms and long-term capabilities through feedback. We trace the conceptual path from homeostasis and feedback control to autopoiesis and biological autonomy. We then distinguish six lines of operationalization: computational autopoiesis, behavior-based robotics, agent formalization, adaptive software, embodied adaptation, and robotic self-modeling. On this basis, we propose a one-boundary, four-loop framework in which Operational, Viability, Reflexive, and Learning loops organize task execution, self-maintenance, metacontrol, and governed learning. Five paired simulation experiments test permission constraints, road-closure response, health maintenance, capability re-estimation, and cross-task learning. Their results provide preliminary evidence for the feasibility of these mechanisms, while broader environments and physical systems remain to be tested.

AI.brief_summary: 论文界定「自主智能体」需在身份与权限边界内同时维持任务目标与存续条件，梳理从稳态调节、反馈控制到自创生与生物自主性的概念脉络，归纳六条操作化路径，并提出含 Operational、Viability、Reflexive、Learning 四个回路的单边界框架，用五组配对仿真初步检验权限约束、道路封闭响应、健康维持、能力重估计与跨任务学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 Reflexive 元控制回路与 Viability 存续监控涉及持续自评、失败检测与控制参数调整，可能为 LVR 中的 STOP 决策、动态计算分配与过程自监控提供问题表述层面的启发，但摘要未给出可与 latent 状态或视觉证据筛选直接对接的机制细节，需核查原文。
